description: Source code for a wizard in Odoo (OpenERP) to change production quantity, including form definition, data retrieval, validation, and update logic.

classes.name: change_production_qty
classes.description: Wizard interface class for changing production quantity with defined states and actions.

methods.name: _get_qty
methods.description: Retrieves current product quantity for the production and sets it as default in the form.

methods.name: _get_states
methods.description: Determines the next state based on the production's current state, raising warnings if necessary.

methods.name: _change_prod_qty
methods.description: Updates the production's product quantity and related stock moves based on the form input.
